prior_art.edition: WebSearches 'Hyndford Breslau 1742 letters to Reinhard van Reede Amerongen in cipher' and 'Hyndford Carmichael Breslau 1742 despatches cipher decipher SP 90 Prussia edition': no edition of letters to Van Reede; Hyndford's own despatches are in TNA SP 87/SP 90 and BL Add MS 35452-92 (Stair letters), the mediation printed in Politische Correspondenz Friedrichs des Grossen; none is shown to contain these Dutch-addressed letters.
prior_art.literature: WebSearch 'Hyndford Van Reede Breslau 1742 Dutch mediation': Carlyle (Friedrich II, vol. 13) has Hyndford and a Dutch envoy 'Ginkel' carrying a joint Dutch-English Advice from Breslau; Reinhard van Reede is heer van Ginkel (geni.com), so the addressee fits the 1742 Breslau mediation. Nothing on a cipher or its decipherment. Inventory calls Hyndford 'generaal' although the 3rd Earl (Carmichael) was a diplomat: identification is presumed, not checked on a leaf.
